name: Prominence wa Kujikenai
original_name: プロミネンスはくじけない
source:
April 1st. It's a magical day where anything can happen.

Lupine and his fairy, Prominence, have too much free time after searching Alice's room. For some reason, a magic circle suddenly appears at their feet, and they are summoned to another world.

They arrived in the library tower. There are two girls summoned there--.

After exploring the tower, can the two return to their original world!?

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/2017_4_1.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
4月1日。这是神奇的一天，任何事情都有可能发生。

卢平和他的仙女普罗尼丝在搜查了爱丽丝的房间后有太多的空闲时间。不知为何，他们的脚下突然出现了一个魔法阵，他们被召唤到了异世界。

他们到达了图书馆塔。那里召唤了两个女孩——。

探索塔楼后，两人能否回到原来的世界！？

[翻译自[url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/2017_4_1.html]官网[/url]]
